name: capture_site
description: Capture a website for a brand or product film: desktop (1440x900), mobile (390x844 @2x) and full-page screenshots, logo candidates (img/svg marked logo, icons, og:image) saved to logos/, the computed colour palette with roles (background, text, accent) and the font families in use. Writes manifest.json in out-dir.

output.description: {path} of manifest.json: {url, title, screenshots, logos, palette, fonts}

params.name: out-dir
params.description: Folder to write screenshots, logos/ and manifest.json
